title: Add RAG sandbox authoring & telemetry quickstart with synthetic-corpus tooling
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: improve first‑time authoring experience for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows by providing a compact, offline-friendly quickstart that demonstrates: (1) synthetic corpus generation for repeatable authoring and tests, (2) lightweight step-mocks and intent-driven assertions, (3) integrated telemetry probes to surface prompt/step regressions, and (4) an optional WASM offline adapter for browsers and CI in resource-constrained environments. This quickstart is targeted at engineers and platform teams who want a reproducible local authoring loop with playbackable scenarios and deterministic eval hooks.

What changed (high level): added a new quickstart folder quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring with a README that walks through authoring, a small TypeScript starter (examples/ts) and a Python worker (examples/py) that show tool-calling stubs, a synthetic-corpus generator (tools/synthetic_corpus.py and tools/synthetic_corpus.ts) that produces seeded documents for offline tests, a step-mock harness (harness/step_mocks.ts) that exposes intent-based expectations, telemetry probe presets (telemetry/presets.yaml) and example dashboards, a wasm adapter shim (wasm/adapter.ts) to run the local runner in browser CI, and CI smoke tests (ci/smoke.yml) that validate response structure and telemetry counters. Also included small docs-site update to reference the new quickstart in the authoring guide.

Checklist: [x] Quickstart README with step-by-step authoring flow and expected artifacts. [x] Synthetic corpus generator (py/ts) with seedable RNG for deterministic tests. [x] Step-mock harness + sample intent tests. [x] Telemetry presets + sample Grafana panels (low-res). [x] WASM adapter and a compact browser runner. [x] CI smoke job that runs local scenario and asserts telemetry counts. [x] Docs site nav entry + cross-links to SDK examples.

Commits (summary): - Initial scaffold quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring with README and template runner. - Add synthetic corpus generator (py + ts) and docs explaining seeding. - Introduce step-mock harness and example test cases. - Telemetry presets and sample dashboards. - Add wasm adapter shim and browser runner demo. - CI smoke job and small docs-site update. - Fix lint failures and address reviewer comments.

Changed areas (selective paths): quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/README.md; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/examples/ts/starter.ts; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/examples/py/worker.py; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/tools/synthetic_corpus.py; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/tools/synthetic_corpus.ts; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/harness/step_mocks.ts; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/telemetry/presets.yaml; quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/wasm/adapter.ts; docs/site/content/authoring/quickstarts.md; ci/smoke.yml; package.json (dev deps); README meta updates for quickstarts index.

Review conversation (high level): - Ethan Brooks: "Great direction — can we keep the corpus generator API minimal and synchronous for first iteration?" / Priya: "Yep, switched generator to a sync seedable API and added usage examples in README." - Maya Feldman: "Telemetry presets look useful; add a small note about cardinality and default retention." / Priya: "Added retention guidance and a runtime opt-out in presets.yaml." - Luca Rossi: "CI job failed lint on the first push due to eslint rules in the TS harness." / Priya: "Addressed lint fixes and added a minimal eslint config in the quickstart to avoid clashing with monorepo defaults." - QA (Jared): "Smoke test is flaky on macOS runners due to filesystem timing." / Priya: "Added a 100ms retry/backoff and explicit tempdir cleanup; reran CI."

CI + merge notes: initial CI run failed lint and a flaky smoke test. After fixes CI passed. Merged with squash on 2026-02-15. Release notes: Adds a new RAG authoring quickstart that includes a synthetic corpus generator, step-mock harness, telemetry presets, and an optional WASM adapter for offline browser-based playback and CI.

Backward compatibility and risks: This is an additive quickstart (docs + examples) with no runtime changes to the serving platform. The only risk is users copying the telemetry presets into high-cardinality setups; guidance is included to avoid that.

How to try it: follow quickstarts/rag-sandbox-authoring/README.md for local setup, run the synthetic corpus generator to create seed=42 artifacts, then run the TS starter or Python worker to exercise tool-calling stubs. The CI smoke job demonstrates a minimal assertion that telemetry counters increment when a step executes.
